squads.name: Forces
squads.theme: Physics you can grab: cloth, gravity and magnetism.

squads.name: Patterns
squads.theme: Simple rules that grow into living structure.

squads.name: Shaders
squads.theme: Whole worlds drawn by one fragment shader.

squads.name: Noise
squads.theme: Instruments made of light. Click to hear them.

demos.title: Silk Storm
demos.tagline: A neon silk curtain in a gale. Grab it, tear it, mend it.
demos.controls: Drag to pull · right-drag or hold X to cut · W gust · R mend
demos.note: The builder never got a test to run, and the cloth hung almost still. The lead rebuilt the physics on a fixed time step, added slack and travelling wind, and brightened the shading.

demos.title: Gravity Garden
demos.tagline: Suns waltz through a galaxy of dust, and you can fling more.
demos.controls: Drag to pull, release to fling a sun · B repel · C reset · Space pause · wheel gravity
demos.note: Shipped as the builder made it. The lead's verdict: spectacular on the first try.

demos.title: Magnet Field
demos.tagline: Iron filings and living field lines ripple as poles flip.
demos.controls: Drag poles · click to add one · F or right-click flips · C reset · Space toggles lines
demos.note: First build was faint and sparse. The lead ordered brighter filings, glowing poles and four poles that flip on their own, and a second builder delivered it.

demos.title: Slime Weave
demos.tagline: Thousands of blind agents spin glowing veins of living light.
demos.controls: Drag to attract · right-drag to repel · Space scatter · 1-3 palette · Up/Down sensor reach
demos.note: First build was one smooth ring with a few stubs. The lead ordered clustered seeding and bloom pulses, then fixed the sparse small-screen view by hand.

demos.title: Attractor Bloom
demos.tagline: Chaos plotted as a morphing ribbon of ember and violet.
demos.controls: Move to bend the shape · click for a random preset · Space next · R random · 1-3 palette
demos.note: First build was flat violet sheets with a blown-out white core. A rework fixed the tone, and the lead traced the leftover violet to a saturated colour index and corrected it.

demos.title: Reaction Garden
demos.tagline: Chemistry that grows glossy labyrinths wherever you touch.
demos.controls: Drag to grow · right-drag to erase · wheel tweaks the feed rate · 1-5 presets · C palette · Space reseed
demos.note: First build opened sparse and mostly empty. The lead switched the opening to the labyrinth recipe with dense seeding and a long warm-up, so it fills the screen from the first frame.

demos.title: Hyperlane
demos.tagline: Ride a glowing neon tunnel that never ends.
demos.controls: Move to steer · hold to boost · Space changes palette
demos.note: First build was a muddy teal haze. The lead ordered dark walls with emissive lattice lines, then made the gate rings white-hot by hand.

demos.title: Tidal Dusk
demos.tagline: A raymarched sea at sunset, drawn by one fragment shader.
demos.controls: Move to look · hold to ascend · T changes time of day
demos.note: First build was nearly all beige sky. After the rework the orchestrator rejected the sign-off because the sea had holes between wave crests; the lead fixed the ray marcher.

demos.title: Fractal Cathedral
demos.tagline: Glide through an infinite Menger-sponge cathedral of light.
demos.controls: Drag to look · hold for speed · wheel to morph · C changes colour
demos.note: First build was a noisy brown fractal seen from outside. The lead threw the idea out and ordered an endless corridor fly-through instead.

demos.title: Drift Garden
demos.tagline: Glowing orbs drift through the dark and sing when they touch.
demos.controls: Move to attract orbs · click to plant one · any key stirs them
demos.note: Passed review without rework. The lead fixed a click in the sound when the oldest voice is cut off, and blotchy trails.

demos.title: Pulse Grid
demos.tagline: A step sequencer with synthesized drums and light that kicks.
demos.controls: Click or drag pads to paint · Space play/pause · R random · C clear · Up/Down tempo · M mute
demos.note: Passed review without rework: the scheduler and voice cleanup were sound. The lead trimmed a full-screen gradient to save fill cost.

demos.title: Aurora Harp
demos.tagline: Strum eighteen strings of light under a northern sky.
demos.controls: Drag across the strings or click to pluck · keys A-L and Q-O play strings
demos.note: Passed review without rework. The lead removed a builder shortcut that would have forced slow rendering on real machines.

steps: Four Sonnet squad leads each chose three demos and wrote a build brief for every one.
Twelve Haiku builders each turned one brief into one HTML file and tested it in a headless browser.
Each lead read the code and the screenshots. Six of the twelve first drafts were rejected and went to a fresh builder with numbered rework orders.
Leads fixed what was left by hand. The orchestrator sent one sign-off back: the ocean had holes in it.
fine: 18 builder runs · 6 reworks · 1 rejected sign-off · all 12 demos pass the smoke test: no script errors, no network requests, animating before you touch them.
